workflow: app launch, transcription startup, user security approval and stop, Computer Use recording-state verification before each explicit public-audio play
limitations: One trial per model, one public 9.3s clip, preview off only. No p50/p95 or failure-rate estimate and no speed ranking.
Different operator pre-roll and post-audio tails; these are not matched capture windows or pure ASR timings.
Observer is read-only but briefly opens clipboard after at least 250ms quiet; it is not zero interference.
Native EDIT change can include fallback typed insertion; clipboard paste and internal app confirmation are not distinguished.
Original Unicode comparison does not verify clipboard formats, monitor-exclusion flags, history/sync, or original clipboard recovery from the earlier failed passive-run-v2 attempt.

Original None cannot produce return confirmation; empty-string Unicode originals are not excluded, and original values were not exported or hashed. Other applications must not copy or type during a trial.
Whisper saved model ID null selects configured worker default; actual revision/device/compute type were not independently collected for this smoke. Do not equate with the earlier pinned batch run.
Main-agent UI observation: Whisper appended an absent stock closing phrase. No transcript/CER is exported or scored for this smoke.
Earlier interrupted trial and idle-only helper versions are excluded; old result files are preserved.
supersedes: issue-88-native-smoke-v2.json (wording clarification only: None is excluded, empty Unicode string is not; same three raw trials, no rerun)
denominator: 3 arm commands, 3 explicit public playbacks, 3 completed native-edit/Unicode-return observations; idle helper versions and earlier interrupted v2 attempt excluded

metrics.t0: time.perf_counter() in passive low-level key hook observing Computer Use-issued Ctrl+Shift+F9 stop; not app recording-state time
metrics.first_native_edit: earliest nonempty same-target Change after t0, captured by native EN_CHANGE notification or fallback EDIT read poll; observation latency, not exact edit or clipboard-paste time
metrics.return_upper: perf_counter() sampled after GetClipboardSequenceNumber sees the final change, later validated by a stable read after >=250ms quiet; reported timestamp is the earlier sequence observation, not the validation read time
metrics.polling: main loop sleeps 5ms nominally; Windows scheduling, UI reads and I/O can widen gaps; actual maximum poll gap was not recorded
metrics.sequence_delta: (last observed clipboard sequence - clipboard sequence sampled while draining stop-key event) modulo 2^32; not count of product-only writes

raw_field_mapping.confirmed_paste_observed: legacy label for native EDIT plus observed Unicode return, not internal app confirmation
raw_field_mapping.text: intentionally blank for privacy, not empty ASR output

observer_provenance.audit: helper independent reviews/rechecks v1-v5; final conservative original=None exclusion and null-read mapping applied and tested BEFORE all three trials, after v5; those two final changes not separately independently rechecked before recording
observer_provenance.original_capture: original = snapshot_text(clipboard), followed by before/after sequence equality, then ClipboardCycle(after, original). snapshot_text uses an independently guarded text-format reader returning str or None or raising; it never returns NOT_TEXT. It does not normalize empty string to None.
observer_provenance.post_trial_recheck: v6 evidence review and v7 bounded recheck verified definitions/numbers and inspected conservative guards; v7 found a wording-only None versus empty-string distinction, corrected in metadata v3/report without changing measured source. No rerun.

isolation_limits: Normal release app remained running; benchmark Ctrl+Shift+F9 differs from its normal shortcut. Absence of other clipboard monitors was not independently established.

Original Unicode content was whatever was present before each arm; helper did not prepare/write it and content was neither exported nor hashed. It may include the earlier failed fixture sentinel; exact origin was not established.
Computer Use activated/clicked the owned EDIT and observed its focus before input; helper also guarded foreground. No OS/in-app privacy or security UI was automated.

All three outputs were observed in the owned native EDIT. Only Whisper showed an extra closing phrase to the main agent; no screenshot/character string was saved for scoring. This single observation followed 11.93s trailing silence and is not generalized.
OS build, VB-Cable version and playback volume were not collected for this exploratory smoke. CABLE Input is the WinMM playback output, captured via CABLE Output; source hash is fixed.
rounding: Durations rounded to 0.01ms for storage; displayed report uses integer ms. This is formatting precision, not demonstrated measurement accuracy.
